svg.text: Gates that must pass before anything ships

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All tests green. A red suite is a blocked release, not a warning.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Version stamp matches package.json and the CHANGELOG entry.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vendored library SHA-256 values still match vendor/README.md.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No exec, eval, or Function constructor anywhere in a shipped file.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Projected posture equals a real rescan on the sample manifest set.

svg.text: A STIG release changes a control id that a citation points at.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A waiver expires and nobody notices the finding came back.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The version constant in the HTML drifts from the CLI. It stamps

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every report, so a stale value misdates your evidence.
The rule that holds the whole thing together
Policy logic lives in exactly one file per toolset. Every GUI, CLI, and test loads that file. If you ever find yourself copying a check into a second place, stop.
Air gapped sites: run step 1 on a connected machine and carry the single generated file across. Steps 2 through 5 need no network.
